description: Spends credits and starts making the images of an image set (all or nothing). shots: shot keys from the plan; leave empty for the default shots. Also adds images to a finished set: pass keys from get_image_set imageSet.moreShots (kinds of images the set does not have yet). Returns at once; images take about 1–3 minutes. Then call get_image_set.

also_locales.description: More image languages, e.g. ["de", "fr"]: made automatically once these images are done, each as its own set (1 credit per image with text per language; others copied free). Check the cost with estimate_cost and locales first.

invent_angles.description: Make other-angle shots (back, side) even when the product has only one photo; the model then guesses those sides (default true)

note.description: The person's own wish for every image of the set, e.g. "autumn mood, warm wood and dried leaves": it shapes the scenes, never the product, and adds no words. Free.

notes.description: The person's own wish per image, by shot key, e.g. {"social-in-use": "a beagle eating from a red bowl"}: it shapes the scene, props, angle or mood, never the product, and adds no words. Free.

rounds.description: Versions of each image to make (default 1), to pick the best with pick_image_version; the main image on white is made once. Cost multiplies.

shots.description: Shot keys to make; default: the plan’s default shots

translate_facts.description: Translate the product facts printed on the images into the set’s language, numbers and units unchanged (default true; false prints them exactly as saved)

name: generate_image_set
title: Generate images
